prompt.zh-TW: 年底，山谷民宿替客房的設備提列這一年的折舊（直線法，耐用年限五年）。這筆調整之後，下面四個數字各會怎麼變？
prompt.en: At year end, Valley Guesthouse records this year’s depreciation on its room equipment (straight-line, five-year useful life). After this adjustment, how does each of the four figures below change?

explanation.zh-TW: 折舊 {{money:e1.amount}} 讓{{term:tm_z971merj}}減少，但沒有任何現金離開帳戶。間接法在「折舊費用(+)」這一列把同樣的金額加回來，一減一加剛好抵銷，所以{{term:tm_e61ht6yh}}不變，資產負債表上的現金也不變。
explanation.en: Depreciation of {{money:e1.amount}} lowers {{term:tm_z971merj}}, yet no cash leaves the account. The indirect method adds the same amount back on the depreciation line, and the deduction and the add-back cancel out, so {{term:tm_e61ht6yh}} is unchanged and so is cash on the balance sheet.
